name: monet
description: A Claude Code adaptation of apple-pi: engineering and team-process skills, 35 role subagents, a session notebook that survives compaction, a .ledger task workbench, Ralph loops, and optional RTK output compression.

rtk.title: Rewrite Bash commands through RTK
rtk.description: Route Bash commands through `rtk rewrite` to compress noisy output. Needs the rtk binary on PATH. Skip this if you already ran `rtk init -g`.

reflect_every_tokens.title: Tokens between learning reflections
reflect_every_tokens.description: After this many new tokens, Claude is asked once to record what it learned in the session notebook. 0 turns it off.
